title: Topological Leray spectral object with its cocycle augmentation
statement: Let $f:Z\to X$ be a continuous map of topological spaces whose direct-image functor on abelian sheaves is additive. Let $HX^n,HZ^n$ be functors on abelian sheaves, with specified equalities to the Ext-defined cohomology presheaf functors evaluated at the terminal opens [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Write $K_X,K_Z$ for the sheafifications of the free abelian representables of the terminal opens. Let $a:K_X\to f_*K_Z$ send each sheafified representable generator $h:U\to X$ to the generator of $f^{-1}h$ followed by the equality $f^{-1}X=Z$. There is an $\operatorname{EInt}$-indexed first-quadrant abelian spectral object $Y$ in the category of functors $\operatorname{Ab}(Z)\to\operatorname{Ab}$, where a spectral object consists of interval cohomology functors $Y.H^n(a,b)$ with functorial maps and exact connecting sequences for nested intervals. There are natural isomorphisms $h_n:Y.H^n(\bot,\top)\simeq HZ^n$ and $e_{p,q}:Y.H^{p+q}(q,q+1)\simeq R^qf_*\circ HX^p$. Define $\delta_p$ to be the derived-zero map $f_*HX^p\to R^0f_*HX^p$, followed by $e_{p,0}^{-1}$, the spectral-object bottom edge $Y.H^p(0,1)\to Y.H^p(\bot,\top)$, and $h_p$. For every abelian sheaf $F$ on $Z$, injective resolutions $I$ of $F$ and $J$ of $f_*F$, chain map $\phi:J\to f_*I$ commuting with augmentations in degree zero, integer $p\ge0$, and cocycles $s:K_X\to J^p$, $z:K_Z\to I^p$ satisfying $a\circ f_*z=s\circ\phi^p$ (composition read left to right), $\delta_p(F)$ sends the class $J.\mathrm{extMk}(s)$ to $I.\mathrm{extMk}(z)$ after the specified transports by $HX,HZ$. No pages, transition maps, stable-page filtration, or factorization through its bottom step are asserted.

proof.text: Apply thm-sp-grothendieck to direct image and terminal sections. Direct image preserves injectives. Abelian sheaves on the small opens sites have the Grothendieck abelian and enough-injectives properties directly from the site-sheaf Mathlib result. Use the common Cartan--Eilenberg augmentation and its equivalent truncation spectral object; natural comparisons give a spectral object in the functor category. Its interval and abutment computations give e and h, transported through HX and HZ.

For the bottom interval, the inverse map from H^p(bottom,1) to H^p(0,1) is followed by the total augmentation. On a comparison J to f_*I the latter sends s to s followed by phi^p. The inverse-image generator formula for a identifies this global section with z under a followed by f_*z = s followed by phi^p. The canonical injective-resolution cohomology computation is I.extMk(z); homotopy independence makes the same computation valid for every pair of resolutions and every comparison commuting with augmentations.
